visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A blue, six-legged cat-like character with large black eyes and a wide, pink-tongued mouth stands on a plain white ground. It gently offers a single green leaf to a small, segmented green larva creature that smiles back. The blue character exhibits a joyful expression with a wide-open smile while the larva stands still on the left. The background is an empty, minimalist white space with no text overlays. (2) Slanted grey lines representing rain fill the frame as the background shifts to a slightly darker grey. The green larva shivers with blue tear-shaped icons above its head, appearing distressed. The blue character opens its mouth to an immense size, showing a bright red interior, and moves to engulf the larva entirely. The character's paws are positioned forward as if reaching out to protect the smaller creature from the wet environment. (3) A yellow sun with a simple smiling face and short radiating lines appears in the upper right corner against a white sky. The blue character is seen curled up sleeping on a flat green lawn, then wakes up with wide eyes. It forcefully ejects a green, cocoon-wrapped object from its mouth onto the ground. The character then displays exaggerated crying expressions with streams of blue tears falling from its eyes. (4) A yellow creature with cat ears, pink butterfly wings, and a bow flies into the air above the green ground, surrounded by yellow sparkle icons. The blue character watches with a happy, open-mouthed expression and its tongue out. A small red heart icon appears between the two characters. The black text 'BUGCAT CAPOO' is centered at the bottom of the frame during this final sequence.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A whimsical, mid-tempo synthesizer melody begins with a bright, plucked texture. There is no background noise. A soft, percussive 'click' sound effect triggers as a leaf is offered. The BGM maintains a playful and high-energy feel with a steady, simple rhythmic pulse. (2) A steady broadband white-noise texture simulating falling rain fades in, accompanying the music. A distinct, wet 'gulp' or 'pop' sound effect occurs, representing a swallowing action. The music remains joyful, creating a contrast with the environmental noise floor of the rain. (3) The rain sound cuts out abruptly. A soft, rhythmic snoring vocalization is followed by a sudden, sharp 'ptooie' burst sound. A high-pitched, exaggerated non-human whimpering sound with high arousal and rapid pitch fluctuations is heard. The BGM continues with a slightly slower, cute melodic variation. (4) A series of shimmering, high-frequency 'sparkle' synthesizer sound effects play in rapid succession. A short, high-pitched happy chirp or 'ya!' vocalization occurs. The BGM swells with a final triumphant major chord. All audio maintains high clarity with a studio-produced spectral balance.
